files.description: Entry point — declares layer order and imports the full system
HTML element defaults and base document styling
Browser reset and low-level element normalization
Theme seed tokens: default font, text, and surface values. Registers them with @property
Raw spacing and size scale. Registers them with @property
Semantic spacing, radius, motion, blur, and z-index tokens. Registers them with @property
Font families, text scale, line heights, weights, and tracking. Registers them with @property
CSS @function helpers for color manipulation and harmony generation
Semantic colors, surfaces, borders, shadows, and color scheme. Registers colors with @property; --color-on-primary upgrades to contrast-color() where supported
Styled elements and components such as buttons, cards, forms, lists, panels, and tables. Also carries native [popover]/<dialog> enter-exit transitions
Layout, spacing, typography, color, state, and responsive utility classes
Attribute-driven utilities via attr() for spacing, typography, transforms, and effects

notes: minChromium values are Chromium/Edge shipping versions; Firefox and Safari differ and are not tracked here.
'required' features must be present for the system to render as designed. 'enhancement' features degrade gracefully and never leave the UI broken.

features.note: Types every design token. Without it tokens still resolve, but invalid overrides are no longer caught and token transitions do not interpolate.
Above the stated 125 floor. Unsupported browsers keep default half-leading, so headings sit slightly lower — visual only.
Headings. Falls back to normal wrapping.
Body copy. Falls back to normal wrapping.
Entry animation for [popover] and <dialog>. Without it they appear instantly.
Pairs with @starting-style so display and overlay can animate.
Textarea auto-grow. Unsupported browsers keep a fixed box with a scrollbar.
Exact Chromium version not verified; gated behind @supports in palette.css. Without support --color-on-primary stays the hardcoded white. Resolves against :root only.
